meaning:
1) to be drowsy, slumber, sleep
1a) (Qal) to slumber, be drowsy

elsewhere.note: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals…
Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.
